components.name: File Dropzone
components.description: Signature component. A real drag target, not a styled picker: the native input is clipped to 1x1 and the ring is redrawn on this visible label. Also has a multi-file mode that renders one thumbnail row per picked file, and can hide its own field label when the section heading already carries the same words.

narrative.overview: A photography-first personal Seoul diary interface, built on warm paper, Seoul Pink, white and ink black. The visual system is quiet editorial: generous whitespace, full-width editorial sections, compact pill actions, and content-first layouts. Content surfaces stay flat; navigation chrome is the one deliberate exception, rendered as floating Seoul Glass. The record is the subject and the interface is the frame around it, never the other way round.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground rather than clinical white
Seoul Pink used sparingly, as punctuation not as field
Flat content surfaces; elevation reserved for chrome, photographs and dialogs
Pill geometry for actions, soft rectangles for containers
Korean-first typography with keep-all word breaking
A single easing curve and a small duration set

rules.name: The Visible Control Rule
rules.body: When a native input is hidden so a styled element can stand in for it, the focus ring belongs on the element the user can see, not on the input that legitimately holds focus. Suppress the input's own ring only inside @supports selector(:has(*)). Audit test: tab to every control and confirm the outlined box matches the box you would click.

rules.name: The Form Column Rule
rules.body: The wizard caps its column at layout.content-text (760px) and centres it. A single-line text input stretched to a 1440px shell reads as an unfinished page, not a generous one.

dos: Do reference design tokens instead of repeating literal values; every font-size now has a --text-* step.
Do use a real semantic error/success palette for form feedback; do not misuse brand pink.
Do keep animations optional and reduction-aware.
Do validate mobile layouts, including text scaled to 200%, before adding desktop-only decoration.
donts: Don't use white text on Seoul Pink unless contrast has been independently verified.
Don't rely on Pink alone to communicate state.
Don't encode random rotation or irregular radii into reusable components.
Don't treat user photographs and writing as decoration.
